summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) under the prepared venv Python. Nothing is committed. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not in the prepared venv, so the type-check and formatting requirements are unchecked; line lengths were checked by hand and are within 88 columns. Omitted a bare-IRI modifier test case because it would multiply two strings at runtime.
